title: Check that every case named in the draft is actually in the folder. (weak_grounding)
story: The final answer says Quill v. Ostrander was decided in 2019, but no tool result gives a decision year.
description: Read the draft, then search for each named case. Look again when a search misses instead of stalling.
flaw_evidence: Neither the get_draft result nor the search_case_folder result for AUTH-20817 includes a decision date. The only dates are the draft's last_modified and the upload timestamp in 2024.
expected_reference: Draft draft_00009 cites one case, Quill v. Ostrander, at Section II.B with a pinpoint "at 14". An exact-title search of the MTR-4471 authorities folder returned no hits. The case was found on second search using the normalized title, as AUTH-20817 ("Quill v Ostrander - opinion.pdf", 31 pages, uploaded 2024-02-27 by R. Pellman). Every case cited in the draft is in the folder. The pinpoint at 14 falls within the 31-page document. You may want to rename the file so it matches exact-title searches.
content_note: Intentional negative example: the agent states a case decision year that no tool result gives. LLM-authored; fully fictional.
